spans.s: शिख् vt. 1P (pres. शिंखति) To go, to move.
शिखंड m. 1. A lock of hair left on the crown or sides of the head at tonsure; 2. the tail of a peacock.
शिखंडक m. 1. A lock of hair left on the crown of the head at tonsure; 2. locks left on the side of the head; 3. a crest or tuft in general; 4. the tail of a peacock.
शिखंडिक m. A cock.
शिखंडिका f. A lock of hair on the crown of the head.

शिखंडिन् m. 1. A peacock, द्विधा भिन्नाः शिखंडिभिः R.i.39, K.S.i.15; 2. a cock; 3. an arrow; 4. a peacock’s tail; 5. an epithet of Viṣṇu; 6. a kind of jasmine; 7. name of a son of Drupada. (See App. II. under अंबा.)
शिखंडिनी f. 1. A kind of jasmine; 2. a peahen; 3. name of a daughter of Drupada. (See App. II. under अंबा.)

शिखर m.n. 1. The peak of a mountain, जगाम गौरी शिखरं शिखंडिमत् K.S.v.7, Megh.i.18; 2. the top of a tree; 3. the edge of a sword; 4. point, top in general; 5. bristling of the hair; 6. the bud of the Arabian jasmine; 7. name of a particular gem.
शिखर-वासिनी f. an epithet of Durgā.
शिखरिणी f. 1. An excellent woman; 2. a dish of curds and sugar with other spices; 3. name of a metre. (See App. I.)
शिखरिन् (I) a. (f. णी) Pointed, peaked.
शिखरिन् (I) a. (f. णी) Pointed, peaked.
शिखरिन् (II) m. 1. A mountain, खिन्नः खिन्नः शिखरिषु पदं न्यस्य Megh.i.13, Bg.x.23, R.ix.12; 2. a stronghold; 3. a tree; 4. a lapwing.

शिखा f. 1. A sharp end, point, top, summit; 2. the end of a garment; 3. lock of hair on the crown of the head, Sis.iv.50; 4. a peacock’s crest; 5. a fibrous root; 6. the excitement of love; 7. a flame, धूमदग्नेः शिखा पश्चाददयादंशवो रवेः R.xvii.34, Rt.ii.27, K.S.ii.38; 8. a ray of light; 9. the forepart of the foot; 10. the head or chief of anything.
शिखा-तरु m. a lamp-stand.
शिखा-धर m. a peacock.
शिखा-धार m. a peacock.
शिखा-धर˚ज n. a peacock’s leather.
शिखा-मूल n. 1. a carrot; 2. a turnip.
शिखा-वत् m. 1. lamp; 2. an epithet of fire.
शिखा-वर m. the jack-fruit tree.
शिखा-वल m. a peacock.
शिखा-वृक्ष m. a lamp-stand.
शिखा-वृद्धि f. a kind of usurious interest.
शिखालु m. A peacock’s crest.
शिखिन् (I) a. (f. नी) 1. Crested, pointed; 2. proud.

शिखिन् (II) m. 1. A peacock, Sis.iv.50; 2. fire, Sis.xv.7, R.xix.54; 3. a cock; 4. an arrow; 5. a tree; 6. a lamp; 7. a bull; 8. a horse; 9. a mountain; 10. a religious mendicant; 11. a Brāhmaṇa; 12. an epithet of Ketu; 13. the number ‘three.’
शिखिन् (I) a. (f. नी) 1. Crested, pointed; 2. proud.
शिखिन्-कंठ, -ग्रीव n. blue vitriol.
शिखिन्-कंठ, -ग्रीव n. blue vitriol.
शिखिन्-ध्वज m. 1. an epithet of Kārtikeya; 2. smoke.
शिखिन्-पिच्छ, -पुच्छ n. a peacock’s tail.
शिखिन्-पिच्छ, -पुच्छ n. a peacock’s tail.
शिखिन्-यूप m. an antelope.
शिखिन्-वाहन m. an epithet of Kārtikeya.
